name: CeeWP Robots.txt Manager
author: CeeWP

sections.description:
CeeWP Robots.txt Manager is a lightweight and user-friendly plugin that allows you to easily manage your WordPress site’s virtual robots.txt file. Add custom rules without creating physical files, with full control over search engine access to your content.

Why Choose Robots.txt Manager?

  • No File Management: Works with WordPress’s built-in virtual robots.txt system
  • Two Operating Modes: Choose between appending to or replacing default rules
  • User-Friendly Interface: Clean admin panel with helpful examples
  • WordPress Standards: Follows all WordPress coding and security standards
  • Automatic Cleanup: Removes all data when uninstalled

Key Features:

  • Simple interface to add custom robots.txt rules
  • Replace Mode: Option to completely replace WordPress default robots.txt with custom rules
  • Append Mode: Add custom rules to existing WordPress robots.txt (default behavior)
  • Dynamic Textarea: Automatically adjusts height based on content
  • Live Preview: Direct link to view your robots.txt file
  • Smart Warnings: Alerts when search engines are discouraged
  • Privacy Respect: Honors WordPress privacy settings
  • Examples Included: Ready-to-use code snippets for common scenarios
  • Professional UI: Modern interface with WordPress dashicons

Perfect for:

  • SEO Professionals: Fine-tune search engine crawling behavior
  • Website Owners: Block access to private directories and files
  • Developers: Prevent indexing of development or staging content
  • E-commerce Sites: Control bot access to sensitive areas
  • Content Creators: Manage sitemap declarations and crawl rates

How It Works:

The plugin adds a new menu item under Settings > Robots.txt Manager where you can easily add your custom rules. Choose between two modes:

  • Append Mode (Default): Your custom rules are added to WordPress’s default robots.txt
  • Replace Mode: Your custom rules completely replace WordPress’s default robots.txt

The interface includes helpful examples, real-time textarea sizing, and a direct link to view your live robots.txt file.

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data. All settings are stored locally in your WordPress database and are only used to generate your robots.txt file.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended):

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “CeeWP Robots.txt Manager”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to Settings > CeeWP Robots.txt Manager to configure

Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ceewp-robots-txt-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  4. Use the Settings > Robots.txt Manager screen to configure your custom robots.txt rules

After Installation:

Visit Settings > Robots.txt Manager to start adding your custom rules. The plugin includes helpful examples to get you started quickly.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin create a physical robots.txt file?

No, this plugin works with WordPress’s virtual robots.txt functionality. It modifies the virtual robots.txt file that WordPress generates automatically.

Will my custom rules override WordPress’s default robots.txt?

By default, no. In Append Mode (default), your custom rules will be added to the existing robots.txt content, and WordPress’s default rules will remain intact. However, if you enable Replace Mode, your custom rules will completely replace WordPress’s default robots.txt.

What’s the difference between Append Mode and Replace Mode?

  • Append Mode (Default): Your custom rules are added to WordPress’s existing robots.txt
  • Replace Mode: WordPress’s default robots.txt is ignored, and only your custom rules are used

Can I switch between modes?

Yes, you can toggle the “Replace Mode” checkbox in the plugin settings to switch between append and replace modes at any time.

What happens if I have privacy settings enabled?

If your site is set to discourage search engines (Settings > Reading > Search Engine Visibility), the plugin will respect this setting and won’t add custom rules since the entire site is already disallowed.

Can I add any type of robots.txt directive?

Yes, you can add any valid robots.txt directive including User-agent, Disallow, Allow, Crawl-delay, and Sitemap directives.

How do I test my robots.txt file?

You can view your robots.txt file by visiting yourdomain.com/robots.txt in your browser. The plugin also includes a direct link to view your live robots.txt file. You can also use Google Search Console’s robots.txt Tester tool.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

When you delete/uninstall the plugin, all custom rules and settings will be completely removed from your database. Your WordPress site will revert to using the default WordPress robots.txt. If you only deactivate the plugin (without deleting), your settings will be preserved for when you reactivate it.

Is this plugin compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, the plugin works with all major caching plugins. Since robots.txt is generated dynamically by WordPress, your custom rules will be included regardless of caching.

Can I use this with multisite installations?

Yes, the plugin works on both single site and multisite WordPress installations. Each site in a multisite network can have its own custom robots.txt rules.

Does this plugin affect website performance?

No, the plugin has minimal impact on performance. It only runs when the robots.txt file is requested and uses WordPress’s built-in filtering system efficiently.
